powerName: Use force reasonably necessary for action under Section 9(2)
description: Section 9(3) states that, in taking any action under Section 9(2), the authorised officer may use such force as may be reasonably necessary.
conditions: The action must be action under Section 9(2).
The officer must be the authorised officer referred to in Section 9(2).
limitations: The statutory wording limits the force to what may be reasonably necessary.
This record is not an instruction or use-of-force guidance.
source: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
